name: teacherA_gan
hypothesis: Lead item A follow-up (15 min, s3d_v2, amended rule as final 2): the unconstrained teacher (2.08M, stride 2) fine-tuned with the SAME adversarial objective as final 2 (spatial + temporal conditional patch D, adv 0.01, temporal 0.01, fm 0.1). The regression teacher showed capacity alone does not bring filaments; final 2 showed the adversarial term on the budget net brings a little texture plus artifacts. Question: does capacity + adversarial objective produce reference-like thin filaments (pictures)? If yes -> distil; if no -> the limit is the screen-space approach / the target, not the net.
